description: Lebanon - Solar Radiation Measurements is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Measurement stations, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Joana Zerbin (World Bank Group). World Bank has awarded Fraunhofer ISE to conduct a Solar Measurement Campaign for 12 months of measurements at 2 sites in Lebanon. Data will be uploaded in batches, on a monthly basis, and will include 1 minute average values for solar radiation components, temperature, air pressure and other auxiliary parameters. Coverage: Lebanon. It has 8 files in CSV, ZIP. The portal files it under Measurement stations, Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
